t: The Erbauer Hex Shank Diamond Tile Drill Bit 18mm x 80mm is engineered for precise and clean drilling through various hard materials. This diamond tile drill bit is ideal for plumbers and tilers working on bathroom and kitchen installations, ensuring a professional quality finish on tiles, porcelain, ceramics, and non-toughened glass without chipping. Its fine diamond grit provides long life and is easy to maintain, featuring self-cooling and self-sharpening properties. The drill bit supports both dry and wet cutting applications, offering versatility on site. A hex shank ensures secure attachment in combi drills, and the slotted barrel design assists with efficient debris removal.
b: Suitable for Tiles, Porcelain, Ceramics & Non-Toughened Glass
